# Audacious Assets — Glassmorphism

Source: [Audacious Assets: Glassmorphism](https://audaciousgabe.itch.io/audacious-assets-glassmorphism)

This private game repository includes:

- the pack's Phosphor SVG icon set under `assets/ui/audacious/`;
- the original hover and pressed interaction modules for reference;
- the original `LICENSE.md`.

The original demo project, imported Godot cache, fonts, scenes, shaders, and
project-management framework are intentionally not vendored. The production
theme in `scripts/ui/KitchenGlassTheme.gd` is a project-specific adaptation
that uses the game's cream, cocoa, teal, oak, and orange palette. The production
button motion in `scripts/ui/AudaciousButtonMotion.gd` is a restrained
adaptation of the pack's pressed-button module.

Do not extract these assets into a standalone asset pack or redistribute them
outside the game; see `LICENSE.md`.
